analysis:
The two units are base-side excerpts of ClusterOnboardingFlow.swift, lines 486-1379. They cover mode selection (automaticIndex, ClusterOnboardingModeAdvice.advise), deployment wording, and sanitisation of catalog and peer text. shownPlainly at line 844 rejects control characters, with length caps at lines 806, 838 and 854. They also cover update re-plan helpers (memberWaitsForLeaderSetup, changed and oneBuild compare pinned worker digests at lines 925-1002), ClusterOnboardingReady status lines, Sync.action and VersionSplit. None of these lines fall in the PR's changed ranges: the base changes start at line 2844 and the head changes at line 1518. This code is UI and planning logic. It touches none of TB-002, TB-011 or TB-007 authorization or crypto, and none of the T-041 cache controls. No regression was identified here.

The file_changes excerpt shows new behavior elsewhere in the file for a later pass:
- Head lines 1518-1525 add operations.stopsAsked and serveUnlessStopped. A start is meant to check the stop count under the leader's start lock so it never undoes a person's stop. This touches availability and stop semantics (A-018).
- provision gains a stopsBefore parameter (head line 2852).

The implementation of serveUnlessStopped, its lock and its ClusterSetupRecord.stopsAsked counter were not supplied. Questions for integration:
- Whether a nil count fails open (the comment says nil means just serve).
- Whether the check is atomic.
- Whether a member Mac (peer) can tamper with the count.

These are coverage limits, not findings.
